comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic finishing media from washers; PR removes an interrupted suture using forceps and a stitch cutter.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bulk granular flow and aperture bridging; PR tests millimetric two-tool coordination, knot lifting, flush cutting, and direction-controlled strand extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery with no washer loss, spill, contamination, or damage and a released 3 s dwell; PR requires a lifted knot, correctly located cut, extraction toward the wound without excessive gap, stitch disposal, instrument return, and 2 s release.
comparison.reason: Suture cutting and controlled extraction test localized dual-instrument manipulation, not size-selective granular screening; no material success detail is missing.
